question: Which of the following Indian monuments is included in the list of UNESCO World Heritage Sites?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khajuraho**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Khajuraho** is an Indian monument that is included in the list of UNESCO World Heritage Sites**
 
• Khajuraho Group of Monuments:
 
 
• It is **Located in Madhya Pradesh, this site is known for its Hindu and Jain temples, which were built between 950 and 1050 CE. **
 
• The temples are famous for their erotic sculptures and carvings, and their Nagara-style architecture.
 
• Most **Khajuraho temples were built between 885 CE and 1000 CE by the Chandela dynasty.**
 
• Historical records note that the Khajuraho temple site had 85 temples by the 12th century, spread over 20 square kilometres (7.7 sq mi).
